purpose.declaration: This amendment binds the original vision documents to the Genesis Block—not for fame, not for recognition, but as a covenant before Allah and family.
purpose.why_bizra: BIZRA (بذرة) means 'seed' in Arabic. The seed is planted to give humans a moment of freedom—space to breathe, to think, to evaluate where they are.
purpose.the_problem: We humans are consumed by a survival loop—a loop we created ourselves. Money became the fuel for darkness, extracting rather than nurturing.
purpose.the_solution: What if we make good deeds profitable? This is why Proof of Impact exists. Not charity as pity, but impact as investment. Not extraction, but cultivation.

origin_documents.primordial_source: Ramadan 2023 (April 2023), Dubai, written in complete solitude
origin_documents.context: The genesis moment—from darkness to light, from scarcity to impact

the_message.subtitle: A Letter from Darkness to Light
the_message.opening_words: I don't know what I'm doing here now in this dark empty space inside myself, and so far alone.
the_message.key_declaration: Here and from this moment, the rules will be different.
the_message.significance: The spiritual genesis—the moment of surrender, of facing oneself, of choosing the path despite fear

the_seed.subtitle: Your Path to Financial and Spiritual Freedom
the_seed.opening_prayer: اللَّهُمَّ لَا عِلْمَ لَنَا إِلَّا مَا عَلَّمْتَنَا (O Allah, we have no knowledge except what You have taught us)
the_seed.key_supplication: رَبِّ اشْرَحْ لِي صَدْرِي وَيَسِّرْ لِي أَمْرِي (My Lord, expand my chest and ease my task)
the_seed.significance: The conceptual genesis—the complete vision of impact-based human flourishing

derivative_works.note: These HTML presentations were created later to visualize the original .md documents

proof_of_impact_genesis.thesis: If money is the fuel for darkness, then impact must become the currency of light.
proof_of_impact_genesis.mechanism: Proof of Impact (PoI) makes verified good deeds economically valuable—not through charity, but through measurable, sustainable value creation.
proof_of_impact_genesis.goal: Free humans from the survival loop. Give them space to breathe. Let them choose impact over extraction.

ethical_foundation.ihsan: Excellence in action, as though observed by the Divine
ethical_foundation.amanah: Trustworthiness and transparency in all dealings

family_covenant.message: You stood beside me through 31 months of solitude, uncertainty, and sacrifice. This system exists because you believed when belief seemed foolish. This amendment seals your patience into the blockchain DNA—not for the world to see, but for Allah to witness.

sadaqah_jariyah.arabic: صدقة جارية لى ولأهلى وللأمة المسلمة والبشرية أجمعين
sadaqah_jariyah.english: Continuous charity for myself, my family, the Muslim Ummah, and all of humanity
sadaqah_jariyah.declaration: This system is declared as Sadaqah Jariyah—perpetual charity that continues to benefit even after the architect passes from this world.
sadaqah_jariyah.hadith_reference: The Prophet ﷺ said: 'When a person dies, all their deeds end except three: a continuing charity (Sadaqah Jariyah), beneficial knowledge, or a righteous child who prays for them.' [Sahih Muslim]

beneficiaries.intention: May this work be a source of good deeds that continues after my time
May this honor the sacrifice of those who stood by me in darkness
May this serve the community of believers with integrity and Ihsān
May this give every human space to breathe, to think, to be free from the survival loop

sadaqah_jariyah.prayer: اللَّهُمَّ اجْعَلْ هَذَا الْعَمَلَ صَدَقَةً جَارِيَةً تَنْفَعُنَا يَوْمَ لَا يَنْفَعُ مَالٌ وَلَا بَنُونَ إِلَّا مَنْ أَتَى اللَّهَ بِقَلْبٍ سَلِيمٍ
sadaqah_jariyah.prayer_english: O Allah, make this work a continuous charity that benefits us on the Day when neither wealth nor children will avail, except one who comes to Allah with a sound heart.

cryptographic_seal.binding_method: This amendment chains to the parent Genesis Block by including its hash, creating an immutable link between the 2023 origin documents and Block 0
cryptographic_seal.verification: Anyone can verify: hash the original .md files with SHA-256 and compare to the content_sha256 values above
cryptographic_seal.immutability: Once committed to the repository, this amendment cannot be changed without breaking the hash chain
